episode.title: Pinned ref mismatch: issue 12683 resolution is in descendant 8003e4c2, not pinned commit 688e8afa
episode.before: At parent commit 99fd76553ec91f07ac4cb321e888f3b4e1ea6031, HookAggregator.mergeWithOrLogic aggregated only the top-level decision field with deny/block precedence. hookSpecificOutput fields, including permissionDecision and permissionDecisionReason, flowed through the generic later-values-win map. PreToolUseHookOutput.getPermissionDecision read hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision before falling back to the top-level decision, and firePreToolUseHook used isDenied() to gate execution, so a later allow could erase an earlier deny.
episode.after: At pinned commit 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a, the hook aggregator, PreToolUse accessor, downstream gating call sites, and existing hook aggregator test are unchanged from the parent, so issue 12683's behavior remains unfixed at the pinned ref. The pinned commit instead changes managed-runtime tool-contract documentation and Java runtime transport/provisioner test files.
episode.diff: A direct parent-to-pinned tree comparison shows exactly seven changed paths: four managed-runtime design documents, HttpRuntimeTransport.java, HttpRuntimeTransportTest.java, and LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerTest.java. No packages/core/src/hooks/** file and no packages/core/src/core/toolHookTriggers.ts file changes. The actual issue fix is local commit 8003e4c2d4f05081f20e4207c18d1aac49994c01, whose parent is the pinned 688e8afa commit; it changes only hookAggregator.ts and hookAggregator.test.ts and is therefore outside the pinned episode boundary.

evidence_units.claim: Closed issue 12683 reports that multiple matching PreToolUse hook decisions are not aggregated by severity: an allow can replace an earlier deny, while the expected precedence is deny > ask > allow regardless of hook order. The separately mentioned parallel-tool-batch hang was explicitly not reproduced.
evidence_units.source: GitHub evidence bundle: issue 12683 body at issue-bundle.json.issue.body

evidence_units.claim: The source-level triage corrects the reported mechanism from completion-time scheduling to deterministic configuration order: executeHooksParallel uses Promise.all, which preserves the input array order; the generic hook-specific merge therefore makes the last configured hook win. The triage also identifies that only top-level decision receives restrictive aggregation.
evidence_units.source: GitHub evidence bundle: issue-bundle.json.comments[1], comment 5829659366, Qwen triage stage 1

evidence_units.claim: Pinned commit 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a has parent 99fd76553ec91f07ac4cb321e888f3b4e1ea6031 and subject feat(sdk-java): Add the v2 tool operations to the runtime transport (#12637), not a PreToolUse or hook-aggregation fix.

The exact parent-to-pinned tree diff contains seven paths: docs/design/2026-09-24-managed-runtime-tool-contract.md; docs/design/2026-09-24-managed-runtime-tool-contract.zh-CN.md; docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-service-core.md; docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-service-core.zh-CN.md; packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/HttpRuntimeTransport.java; packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/HttpRuntimeTransportTest.java; and packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/LocalProcessRuntimeProvisionerTest.java.

evidence_units.claim: At pinned 688e8afa, HookAggregator.mergeWithOrLogic marks hasBlock only from output.decision values block or deny. It then copies hookSpecificOutput entries into otherHookSpecificFields with later values winning, excluding only additionalContext and artifacts; permissionDecision and permissionDecisionReason have no special handling.

At the pinned ref, PreToolUseHookOutput.getPermissionDecision reads hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision first and only then maps the top-level decision field; isDenied() returns true only when that accessor returns deny. Thus a generic overwrite of the hook-specific field takes precedence over top-level restrictive aggregation.

At the pinned ref, HookSystem.firePreToolUseEvent returns only result.finalOutput through createHookOutput, while firePreToolUseHook evaluates the returned PreToolUseHookOutput with isDenied() and isAsk(). The discarded allOutputs collection is therefore not available downstream to recover an earlier deny.

At the pinned ref, hookEventHandler constructs allHookConfigs by concatenating registryHookConfigs and sessionHookConfigs, and hookRunner.executeHooksParallel maps those configs into promises and returns Promise.all(promises), preserving the input/configuration order in the result array.

The pinned hookAggregator.test.ts tests restrictive behavior for the top-level decision field with an allow output and a block output, but contains no multi-output test for hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision or its precedence/reason.
evidence_units.source: Checkout: 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a:packages/core/src/hooks/hookAggregator.test.ts at the mergeWithOrLogic - PreToolUse tests

evidence_units.claim: The actual issue-fix commit 8003e4c2d4f05081f20e4207c18d1aac49994c01 is a direct child of pinned commit 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a. Its subject explicitly says it ranks PreToolUse permissionDecision most-restrictive and its message says Fixes #12683.

Comparing child fix 8003e4c2d4f05081f20e4207c18d1aac49994c01 with pinned parent 688e8afa changes exactly two paths: packages/core/src/hooks/hookAggregator.ts and packages/core/src/hooks/hookAggregator.test.ts. The pinned commit itself does not contain these changes.
evidence_units.source: Checkout: recursive git ls-tree comparison of 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a and 8003e4c2d4f05081f20e4207c18d1aac49994c01

evidence_units.claim: The linked PR resolution describes the actual fix as ranking hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny > ask > allow, making the reason follow the winning rank, preserving same-rank reason concatenation, and leaving unrelated hook-specific fields last-wins.
evidence_units.source: GitHub evidence bundle: issue-bundle.json.timeline entry for PR 12689, pull-request body

evidence_units.claim: The linked PR body reports regression coverage for both deny/allow orders, deny/ask, allow/ask, same-rank reasons, single-hook behavior, and unrelated fields; it reports the hookAggregator test, hooks-directory tests, toolHookTriggers test, and TypeScript check as passing. These validation claims belong to descendant fix 8003e4c2, not to pinned 688e8afa.
evidence_units.source: GitHub evidence bundle: issue-bundle.json.timeline entry for PR 12689, pull-request body, Reviewer Test Plan and Evidence sections

unresolved_questions: The pinned ref 688e8afa0c771c710d297f88fc20c6c2a899466a is not implementation-bearing for issue 12683; its parent-to-pinned diff is an unrelated managed-runtime SDK/design change, so no usable ChangeEpisode can be promoted at this cutoff.

The linked resolution is available as descendant commit 8003e4c2d4f05081f20e4207c18d1aac49994c01, with merged equivalent c9a9a8ad147744085487738f51e1618057c9baa5. A corrected implementation ref is required if the intended task is to extract the actual PreToolUse permission-ranking actions and workflow.

The issue report describes completion-time nondeterminism, but the checked source and triage evidence establish deterministic last-in-configuration-order behavior; this distinction should be retained if the implementation ref is corrected.
